message: 頼りにしてる

name: Melilot
message: 「It seems everyone is here.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So we're finally starting serious special training for Re-Crea, aren't we!」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't make it sound like we haven't been doing anything until now.」

name: Sally
message: 「Do your best, everyone!」

name: Misa
message: 「Sally-san, don't act like this doesn't involve you either.」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm just in it for the delicious food we're getting as a reward~♪」

name: Melilot
message: 「I know you are all busy with Student Council activities, but I will not be holding back, so please be prepared.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh yeah, my arms are itching for a fight!」

name: Ria
message: 「Let's all get stronger together and make it through Re-Crea.」

name: Misa
message: 「And while we're at it, let's beat up those bad guys who are targeting Sakura-kun and the others!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, can the likes of us truly manage to do something about it...?」

name: Ria
message: 「If it's that, we'll be fine.\s07」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah. After all...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We've got the Demon Lord on our side!」
That's right--
Everyone in the Crusaders now knows that I'm the Demon Lord, along with the fact that Melilot-san is a demon.
With Melilot-san encouraging me, I didn't feel much hesitation about confessing the truth.
And everyone accepted us without a hitch, so...
By now, it feels as natural as if things had always been this way from the start.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I still haven't trained nearly enough, though.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's why we're doing special training, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「True.」

name: Melilot
message: 「At present, we have not yet fully grasped the true nature of this upcoming Re-Crea, however...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Judging from the observation data, the one thing that is certain is that the power of the Demon Lord will become necessary.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I have high expectations for you, Sakura-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes!」
With Melilot-san counting on me, I can't let her down.
No matter what, I have to become a flawless Demon Lord and save this world.
Especially if that's Melilot-san's wish, and everyone else's wish too.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mgh... Synn, the way you're looking at Melilot-san seems kinda suspicious!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?! That's not true at all, my thoughts are totally pure!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Using special training as an excuse to hope for some bashful, lucky pervert moments--truly worthy of the Demon Lord!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Oh my, I'm starting to feel like I'm in danger」

name: Misa
message: 「What a pervert you are at a time like this!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「He is the President, after all, so it can't be helped」

name: Lolotte
message: 「As the saying goes, when the female faces west, the male faces east」

name: Synn
message: 「What's that supposed to mean」

name: Ria
message: 「Now, now. Anyway, let's get the training started\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Right」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hooold it right there!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hearing about special training, I simply cannot stand idly by!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, it's Mako-chan. What are you doing here?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nuhuhu!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Wherever there is a chance to hone oneself, there you shall find Lady Macaron!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I definitely didn't get lost while taking a walk or anything, okay!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see, so she's a lost child」

name: Macaron
message: 「I am not! I'm not lost!」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Macaron-san, will you be joining us for training as well?」

name: Macaron
message: 「W-Well, yeah!」

name: Macaron
message: 「My big brother beat me to it, though...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm gonna become a full-fledged Demon Lord right away and blow right past him!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Heehee... How reliable.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Well then, shall we begin?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, we're jumping straight into a mock battle?」

name: Ria
message: 「Practice like it's the real thing, and treat the real thing like practice...」

name: Ria
message: 「After all, actual combat is the best way to get used to real battles\s07」

name: Paqy
message: 「You won't know until you actually touch it... Spoken like a true Ria-chan!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Without further ado, face―first into those boobs―」

name: Paqy
message: 「Genom!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Jeez, you can't let your guard down for a second」

name: Sally
message: 「Fight on, everyone~♪」

name: Misa
message: 「You're participating too!」

name: Sally
message: 「Uwaaaah!」

name: Ria
message: 「When we take a break, I'll give you some yummy sweets\s07」

name: Sally
message: 「Yay~♪」

name: Melilot
message: 「Now then, Sakura-kun」

name: Melilot
message: 「First, let's calm down and take it slow without rushing」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please make that power your own, slowly and steadily」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Aaalright! Special training, start!」
